name: Nesta
description: Nesta is a lightweight Ruby CMS built on Sinatra that serves Markdown and Haml pages and can export them as a static site with nesta build.
notes: Static export through nesta build. Nesta reads Key: value header blocks, so a local app.rb teaches its page loader YAML front matter (3minus); tilt is pinned to 2.4.0 because haml-contrib needs Tilt::MarukuTemplate. firstRelease from the first RubyGems release (2010-12-20).
